extraction_notes: This is a family datasheet; the exact BZX84C18 row was selected from the BZX84C2V4 through BZX84C75 electrical-characteristics table for manufacturer hongjiacheng.
The supplied PDF identity was verified as LCSC C19077473, MPN BZX84C18, manufacturer hongjiacheng, with SHA-256 39b6ea9e2fb90c0f556434867115de516305a365515113676b906ff1ade79e83.

The BZX84C18 electrical-characteristics row gives inclusive VZ bounds of 16.8 V minimum, 18.0 V nominal, and 19.1 V maximum at IZT = 5 mA; maximum ZZT = 45 ohm at IZT and maximum ZZK = 225 ohm at IZK = 1 mA.

The exact row gives maximum reverse leakage IR = 0.1 microA at VR = 12.6 V, admissible IZM = 5 mA, and typical temperature-coefficient bounds of 12.4 to 16 mV/degC at IZTC; TA = 25 degC unless otherwise noted.

The five zener-characteristic points are direct approximate graph-read observations from the visible BZX84C18 trace labeled 18 in p. 3 Fig. 2 at labeled logarithmic-current grid values; source-axis current in mA was converted to A and no points were interpolated.

No component-specific capacitance or reverse-recovery-time specification is published in the supplied datasheet. The p. 3 capacitance and dynamic-impedance plots are family-level typical characteristics without a uniquely identified BZX84C18 trace and were not assigned component-specific points.
Maximum ratings include PD = 300 mW and forward voltage VF = 0.9 V at IF = 10 mA on p. 1; junction and storage temperature limits are -55 to +150 degC and typical RthetaJ-A is 417 degC/W.
